description.content:
Count task runs.

Required workspace scopes: `see_flows`

Query for task run history data across a given range and interval.

Required workspace scopes: `see_flows`

Get all artifacts created within a task run, including artifacts from
subflow runs spawned by this task (recursively).

Required workspace scopes: `see_flows`

query.description: Optional depth limit for recursion (0 = task run only)
Only return artifacts created on or after this timestamp
Only return artifacts created on or before this timestamp
Sort order by creation time (asc or desc)

description.content:
Get all asset materializations from a task run, including materializations
from descendant runs.

Returns a historical snapshot of materializations as they occurred, with asset
properties captured at materialization time (not current state).

Required workspace scopes: `see_assets`

query.description: Optional depth limit based on execution hierarchy. depth=0: only the task run. depth=1: task run + its descendants. None: unlimited depth (default).
Only return materializations on or after this timestamp
Only return materializations on or before this timestamp
Sort order by occurred time (asc or desc)

description.content:
Get all asset references from a task run, including references from
descendant runs.

Returns a historical snapshot of asset references as they occurred, with asset
properties captured at reference time (not current state).

Required workspace scopes: `see_assets`

query.description: Optional depth limit based on execution hierarchy. depth=0: only the task run. depth=1: task run + its descendants. None: unlimited depth (default).
Only return references on or after this timestamp
Only return references on or before this timestamp
Sort order by occurred time (asc or desc)
